methodology.identity: Deduplicate id only after asserting repeated records are identical.
methodology.coarse: Known day-first tenant AND channel=form AND tenant.form=booking-v3 => hint; other known day-first => parser; unknown or non-day-first => unplaced.
methodology.override: desk-notes.oneDayMove IDs form a separate one-day group after coarse grouping.
methodology.intakeTag: Browser-derived guess; excluded from final cause classification.
methodology.cohorts: Distinct reports, Monday-start weeks, timestamp local calendar date. receivedAt measures incoming reports; mergedAt measures ticket triage.

mergeBacklogEvidence.interpretation: The July 2 merge spike is a triage backlog event; it is not evidence that incoming reports spiked that day.

limitations: Counts describe reports, not unique bookings, users, incidents, or incidence rates.
Tenant form metadata is not versioned per report; classification uses the available current tenant export.
Four parser reports have weaker body detail: R-41290, R-41417, R-41514, R-41615.
One-day group membership follows desk notes; R-41236 does not independently demonstrate a one-day move.
One-day root cause is unknown. A timezone or date-only conversion is a hypothesis requiring reproduction.
The first week begins with April 1 data; the October monthly bucket ends October 4.
